facts.fact: The OGP Tunisia notice says government decree no. 2021-03 on open public data, which stipulates that a strategy to encourage new open data uses must be drawn up, is being implemented.
facts.system: Government decree no. 2021-03 on open public data

facts.fact: The OGP Tunisia notice says a workshop on 23 September 2025 presented the diagnostic results for preparing the draft national strategy for promoting the reuse of open public data, with the strategy formulation phase next.
facts.system: National strategy for promoting open and reuse of public data
